events.WelcomeNextClicked: User clicks Next on the welcome landing page
events.TermsOfServiceViewed: User opens the Terms of Service popup
events.TermsOfServiceClosed: User closes the Terms of Service popup
events.PwaConfirmationNext: User clicks Next on the PWA confirmation step
events.SetupChoiceSelected: User selects create new wallet or recover existing
events.SeedPhraseGenerated: New seed phrase generated for wallet creation
events.SeedPhraseSaved: User confirms they have saved their seed phrase
events.SeedPhraseEntered: User enters seed words for wallet recovery
events.WalletRecovered: Wallet successfully recovered from seed phrase
events.SetupMintAdded: User adds a mint URL during setup
events.SetupMintRemoved: User removes a mint URL during setup
events.MintConnectionTested: Connection test result for a mint URL
events.WalletSetupCompleted: User completes wallet setup and navigates to Portfolio

currentState.showTerms: Whether the Terms of Service popup is visible
currentState.choice: User's selected path (create or recover), null if not yet chosen
currentState.seedSaved: Whether user confirmed saving seed phrase
currentState.mintConnections: List of mints with connection test status
